public.title: Graph Valid Tree
public.description: Return whether edges form a connected undirected tree on vertices 0 through n-1. n is 1 to 500; there are at most 1000 pairs of distinct vertices, with no duplicate undirected edges.
hints: A tree needs n-1 edges and no cycle.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Union-find rejects an edge whose endpoints are already connected. With n-1 acyclic edges all vertices are connected. Near-linear time.
